# Electronic Lockpick
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

*Use it at a locked vehicle to break its lock, a crafted lock cannot be broken.*

|:--|:--|
| Size | 2 |

## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

- Crafted, see below.

## Crafting

**Made by**

- At a [Workbench](Workbench) with a [Screwdriver](Screwdriver) (kept): [Flux Capacitor](Flux-Capacitor) + [Locksmith Kit](Locksmith-Kit) + [Power Supply](Power-Supply) + 2× [Refined Metal](Refined-Metal)

## Scrap

Worth 1 [Scrap Metal](Scrap-Metal) in a Scrap Machine, see [Scrap](Scrap).
